description: This file handles JSON responses for retrieving workflow templates for a specific module in vtiger CRM. It loads necessary dependencies, defines a function to fetch templates via the VTWorkflowTemplateManager, and outputs the data as a JSON-encoded array.

classes.name: VTWorkflowTemplateManager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing workflow templates in vtiger CRM, used here to fetch templates for a specific module.

methods.name: vtTemplatesForModuleJson
methods.description: Fetches workflow templates for a given module and returns them as a JSON array.
